mentions.name: Drunk Woodcutter
mentions.description: A game about cutting firewood while drinking beer. Cutting logs lets the player sell firewood to buy increasingly absurd upgrades such as axes, wood types, and booze, and the player can even hack themselves in the kneecap. It is a first commercial Steam release, in development for eight months.
mentions.source_excerpt: A game about cutting firewood while drinking beer. Cutting logs lets you sell firewood, which you spend on increasingly absurd upgrades (axes, wood types, booze). And yes, you can absolutely hack yourself in the kneecap!
